entities.summary: Paul Stewart Atkins is an American businessman who has served as chair of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) since April 2025. Atkins also previously served as a commissioner at the SEC from 2002 to 2008. Known for advocating reduced regulatory burdens and promoting financial innovation, Atkins has been a vocal supporter of free-market principles in regulatory policy.
